ghcr.io/nokia/mcp-redfish:0.3.10.overview:
## Redfish MCP Server

The mcp-redfish server is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables AI assistants and agents to interact directly with systems that expose the Redfish API, the industry-standard RESTful interface for out-of-band hardware management. It allows AI-driven workflows to inspect server hardware, firmware, power state, and health information without switching tools or manually navigating vendor-specific management consoles. This server is especially useful for data center operations, hardware monitoring, infrastructure troubleshooting, and AI-assisted systems management workflows.
